description: This file defines the SymfonyMailer class, an experimental Drupal mail backend implementation using the Symfony mailer component. It handles email formatting and sending via configured DSN transports, acting as a drop-in replacement for the default PHP mail plugin.

classes.name: SymfonyMailer
classes.description: An experimental Drupal mail backend class implementing MailInterface and ContainerFactoryPluginInterface, utilizing Symfony's mailer component for email delivery.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of SymfonyMailer with the logger service from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting logger and optional mailer service.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats email message parts, converting HTML to plain text and wrapping non-HTML parts.

methods.name: mail
methods.description: Builds and sends an email using Symfony's Email object, handling headers and recipients.

methods.name: getMailer
methods.description: Provides a minimal Symfony mailer service, initializing it with DSN configuration if not already set.
